reason: Based on the repository description and manifest, the plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is enabling file attachment handling in the DeepSeek Harness web chat (select, paste, and drag/drop upload, workspace storage, and card-style display), so it is best classified as a files and tooling utility plugin rather than automation, testing, or external-integration tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 聊天界面中通过按钮、粘贴或拖拽上传文件，并在输入框和聊天记录中以卡片展示，上传文件保存到会话工作区以供后续读取和查看。
summaries.en: This plugin enables file attachments in the DeepSeek Harness web chat via folder selection, paste, or drag-and-drop, then displays uploaded files as cards and stores them in the session workspace for retrieval in conversation flow.

capabilities: file upload in web chat input
server-side upload endpoint and workspace storage
file retrieval for chat-record attachment opening

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a web chat attachment flow via folder button, paste, and drag-and-drop and stores files in the session workspace uploads directory.
README and package metadata describe a dual-host/client design where the host registers routes and the client uploads files and renders attachment cards.
The plugin documentation includes GET/POST routes for uploading and opening files, which introduces local server file handling and file-serving behavior.

capabilities: file upload in web chat input
server-side upload endpoint and workspace storage
file retrieval for chat-record attachment opening
